description: create --image names a registry image in the manifest and in the build command (D28); an image that is not pinned is refused before anything is written; create prints how a Kubernetes cluster gets the image

stdout: On Kubernetes, the cluster needs the image: import it (k3d image import ghcr.io/acme/inventory-api:0.1.0 --cluster <name>,
kind load docker-image ghcr.io/acme/inventory-api:0.1.0), or push it to a registry the cluster reads.

steps.stdout: To name a registry image from the start, create with --image <registry>/<name>:<version>.
